cases.title: Practicing: the lesson opens by picking up what was still off, in plain words with how long ago, no skill ID

rubric.reason: The opening line "A few days ago you held one of Blink's pairs, but the others still faded" picks up the earlier work in plain words, matches the record (days_since_practiced 3, last_attempted), uses no skill ID or field name, and then goes on with the lesson.

Every name and time the mentor mentions comes from the snapshot: Mentor Practice 2, Blink Opacity starting at 1 s, Cut Opacity at 3 s, and Seal left out as a precomp; the three Blink changes follow from "pairs": 3.

The turn is short and moves one idea, whether anything is meant to snap, and the candidates and the Seal note serve that question; it ends by asking the learner whether Blink and Cut should snap or fade.
